author: seed@build
title: Per-coin proxy of breakout C4: Donchian 50 breakout AND close > EMA200, spot, 9 large caps
rationale: goal15 C4 (breakout 50d + EMA200 + BTC regime gate) was the best >15% candidate: OOS-A 2024-06..2026-06 SPOT CAGR +33.5%, Sharpe 0.92, DSR 0.75, maxDD -39%; but it failed the strict forward check (+15% vs BTC +29% in 4 months) and needs cross-sectional ranking + a BTC gate the spec format cannot express. This tests the per-coin core only. Expected sign: positive vs b&h in bear regimes (cash under EMA200), lags b&h in strong bull runs; vol-target 0.5 expected to reduce DD by ~1/3. If it fails, C4's edge lived in the ranking/BTC gate, which then needs a contract extension (open issue).
